title: Asymptotic Margins and Feature Confinement in Conic Classification Heads under Softmax Cross-Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2611.18507v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classification heads built on conic functions give each class a bounded region of the feature space, and such regions are used to reject samples of unseen classes. We ask whether these regions also keep the features bounded when the head is trained with softmax cross-entropy. For a head whose class scores combine a linear term with a Euclidean norm, we first show that the region of each class is bounded by a quadric of revolution, whose eccentricity is the reciprocal of one learned ratio. We then attach to each class an asymptotic margin, which compares the growth of its score with the growth of all the other scores and can be computed by a second-order cone program. The loss of a class has infimum zero exactly when its margin is positive, and it then approaches zero only along diverging features. translated_title: Softmax交叉熵下锥形分类头中的渐近间隔与特征约束
translated_abstract: 基于锥函数构建的分类头为每个类别赋予特征空间中的一个有界区域，这些区域可用于拒绝未见类别的样本。我们提出的问题是：当该分类头使用softmax交叉熵训练时，这些区域是否也能使特征保持有界。对于类别得分由线性项与欧几里得范数相结合的分类头，我们首先证明每个类别的区域由一个旋转二次曲面所界定，其离心率是某个学习到的比率的倒数。随后，我们为每个类别定义一个渐近间隔，该间隔比较其自身得分增长与所有其他得分增长的情况，并可通过二阶锥规划进行计算。当且仅当一个类别的间隔为正时，其损失的下确界为零，且损失仅在特征发散时才趋近于零。当间隔为负时，损失是强制的，其极小值点位于一个显式给定的球内。由于softmax仅依赖于差异……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 论文为锥形分类头引入了可由二阶锥规划计算的渐近间隔，并证明该间隔的正负决定了softmax交叉熵训练下特征是否有界：间隔为正时损失仅在特征发散处趋近于零，间隔为负时损失强制且最优解位于一个显式球内。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a per-class asymptotic margin, computable via a second-order cone program, that determines whether conic classification heads trained with softmax cross-entropy keep features bounded: with a positive margin the loss vanishes only along diverging features, while a negative margin yields a coercive loss whose minimizers lie in an explicit ball.
